checks.why: check-macos (lint+check+test) and check-windows (compile guard) moved off the PR path to main-only; this is the reproducible-on-Linux subset of that coverage (Rust workspace + app/src-tauri type-check and nextest, plus the Svelte frontend). The macOS-only surface (os-integration's macos module, Metal/parakeet backends) and the Windows compile guard aren't reproducible on this machine and stay covered by push:main and release.yml, per the CI contract. serial+lock: a full workspace cargo build is memory-hungry on this shared box, so it queues against other checkouts' cargo builds rather than piling on
